mapper.select: SELECT status FROM incident WHERE id = #{incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM operational_period WHERE incident_id = #{incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT id, incident_id, operational_period_id, created_by_account_id, police_phone_id, marker_source FROM marker WHERE id = #{markerId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND status <> 'DELETED' LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident_assignment WHERE account_id = #{accountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND revoked_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM police_phone WHERE id = #{policePhoneId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND registered = TRUE
